Subject: Private VPC demo & HIPAA controls

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding flow — we just signed up and ran a quick smoke test. We're evaluating Redwood for a PHI-bearing pipeline and the Private/VPC deployment is a hard requirement for us.

Can we schedule a technical demo focused on:
- network & firewall requirements
- KMS/HSM and key management options
- audit logs & retention
- deployment models (VPC vs on-prem)

Our SRE (Aisha Rao) and security lead will join. Best windows next week are Tue/Wed mornings PT. Also please share any pre-demo checklist so our infra team can unblock the demo quickly.

Jordan
Jordan Myers
Director of ML Engineering
MedSecure

Hi Jordan — great to meet you and congrats on the sign-up. Happy to run a focused demo with the SRE/security folks.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-06-23 09:30–10:00
- Tue 2026-06-23 11:00–11:30
- Wed 2026-06-24 09:30–10:00

I'll include our Solutions Engineer, Dev Patel, to cover network and deployment prerequisites. Attaching our private-deploy-checklist and network-requirements spreadsheet — these list the usual firewall rules, IP ranges, and inbound/outbound ports. Please share Aisha's preferred slot; if none of the above work, drop 2 alternatives.

Draft agenda:
1) 15m technical walkthrough (network, KMS, audit logs)
2) 10m deployment options and timeline (VPC vs on-prem)
3) 5m next steps / procurement checklist

Also, if you need an NDA signed ahead of time we can route a quick DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@medsecure.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Aisha Rao <aisha.rao@medsecure.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC demo & HIPAA controls

Thanks Marissa — Tue 6/23 09:30 PT works for Aisha and me.

A couple quick notes before the call:
- We have strict egress policies and want to minimize outbound endpoints; can you confirm whether Redwood's Private option requires any persistent outbound connections to a managed control plane or whether it can be fully customer-controlled?
- Procurement is likely Q3; we need to know rough licensing model for Dedicated/Private so we can flag budget.

I'll add our network diagram to this thread if helpful.

Jordan

From: dev.patel@redwood.ai
To: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@medsecure.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-18T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC demo & HIPAA controls

Hi Jordan — Dev from Solutions Engineering here. Quick answers up front:
- Redwood Private can be deployed either with a customer-managed control plane (no outbound required after initial bootstrap) or with a hybrid mode that keeps a light control channel to our control plane. We can demo both options and show which control-plane traffic to expect.
- Licensing: I'll bring a one-page summary (Committed Dedicated vs Private license) and a sample procurement timeline to the call.

Pre-demo asks (so we can demo a relevant setup):
1) Do you have an internal NAT or egress proxy that would block outbound traffic? If so, please share an IP allowlist request window or we can demo with the hybrid mode.
2) Who is your KMS provider (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, HSM)?
3) Any specific retention/audit log export requirements (SIEM integrations)?

Agenda updated: technical + procurement summary + next steps (contractual touchpoints). I'll prepare a short diagram and the licensing summary and upload to the HubSpot deal record.

—Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
